activities.description: I wanna say I'm in a similar boat. My class size is only 200 and the students here are also not really motivated. I can't speak for how it's going to work out for the ivies because I didn't apply, but I did get into a college with an 11% acceptance rate, so I think as long as you be your best self, you have a good shot at it! Good luck to you!
